ModMetaData.name: The Rites
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The liturgy tree: five rites the clan does not buy but is given, as the ship remembers. Scrap Shrine, Conduit Choir, God-Speaker Array, Liturgy of the Hull, and the day The Gods Speak Back.
Authored 2026-09-04 on the owner's ruling (RESEARCH_TREE_NORMALIZATION_1 rulings block). v1 ships the tab and the five ResearchProjectDefs, chained T0..T4. The revealed-not-bought gate is RULED (owner 2026-09-04): each tier past the Scrap Shrine carries a hidden prereq on an Antiquities stage — Choir needs LANGUAGE, God-Speaker RELIGION, Hull CULTURE, Gods Speak Back VOICE (design/Jawa/antiquities_design.md section 2; built by ANTIQUITIES_TREE_BUILD_1). Until that build lands these rows are researchable like any other — acceptable for review, wrong for shipping. Subspace gravitic penetration's flavor folds into the God-Speaker Array per design/Jawa/research_review/functionless_tech_candidates.md.
